Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GOOGL.
Our cloud segment grew 9% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
We generated $10.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 9% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $14.8 billion this quarter, representing 9% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Revenue guidance of $14.8 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
